title: Nature poster
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Friends of nature; Layla in the snow; Salem at the zoo
source: Written for arabic/y4 lesson 8 (Pupil PDF worksheet: nature poster)
intro: Lesson 8: Friends of nature: plants and animals. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: This is ...
points: هٰذِهِ شَجَرَةٌ: this is a tree
هٰذَا نَهْرٌ: this is a river

panels.title: Friends of nature
points: We do not harm trees and animals
Allah made the earth for us to look after

blocks.text: Draw and label each picture in Arabic. Then write two sentences with هٰذَا or هٰذِهِ.

questions.q: Nature poster on the pupil PDF: label six pictures (tree, flower, bird, river, mountain, sun) and write two هٰذَا / هٰذِهِ sentences.
questions.a: Correct labels; for example هٰذِهِ شَجَرَةٌ، هٰذَا عُصْفُورٌ

questions.q: Extend: say 'the bird is on the tree'.
Stretch: say one way to be a friend of nature in Arabic or English.
questions.a: For example: I water the flowers: أَسْقِي الزُّهُورَ

questions.q: Think again: what would nature ask us?
